main_text.head: DE ROMANAE ECCLESIAE IDOLOLATRIA Liber secundus.
CAP. I.

head.i: Ex idololatriæ definitione convinci Pontificios idololatras esse. Eam à Iesuitis futiliter & ineptè in quæstionem vocari.

main_text.p: ECCLESIAM Romanam, quo nomine complector, non omnes Christi fidem Romæ profitentes, inter quos fortasse sunt, qui suspirent propter abominationes ibi perpetratas, ut {a}erant olim Ierosolymis; Ezek.9.4.sed eos qui Romanis superstitionibus & communione Pontificis se contaminant: istâ[?] ergò Ecclesiam, hoc est, Papistas & Pontificios idololatriæ lepra laborare convincit ratio manifestissima. Nã QVIS-QVIS CREATVRÆ DIVINVM CVLTVM EX-HIBET, COMMITTIT IDOLOLATRIAM. At

page.notes: The faint mirrored text at the top of the page (show-through from the other side) and in the left margin was not transcribed. The woodcut ornaments and the "***" ornament are not printed text. "istâ" after "contaminant" is doubtful: the letters run together in the scan. "Nã" is read as Nam with a tilde. The running head is absent. The line "X 4" is the gathering signature.
